notes.title: Now on ready for amusing demo
notes.notes:
Hi all, this is Developer Mango.
"Dragon Forest" is growing up well everyday.

About 4 months have been passed since it was initiated, it seems like there was a big change comparing to its early phase.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478824/9bbb7b5dc719a1c40aea6e2ebca6c1f91584b0fc.png[/img]


It looks not bad, right?
It is quite amusing when I play it, too.

Suddenly, some thoughts have passed through my head, like "Is it amusing just for me?".
My friends told me it's fun but...it might have been a lie.

From now, I think it's time to listen the voice from you.
Because I don't want to make the game whick is amusing "only for me!".

So I'm working so hard to develop the demo now.
It would be uploaded around early February.

I gotta go back to the demo.


Stay tuned, guys!
